implementationPlan.description: At the eventual WORKING claim, re-read the active plan/amendments and prerequisite completion summaries, then re-measure HEAD, `git status --porcelain -- <the nine owned paths>`, physical production-file line counts, imports, and `git grep -l` reachability for `recordSafeBoundaryObservation`, `readGoalBudgetIdentity`, the worktree materializer, and the three durable layer constants. Stop for an amendment if any owned path is dirty/owned by a concurrent live row or a newly landed prerequisite changes the measured seams. Before edits, record the merge-base failure-path baseline for `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (root lane only), `pnpm verify:foundation`, `pnpm verify:store`, `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, and the full durable-store security file; this is attribution evidence, not a mid-task pass gate. Preserve the current master-roster failures as foreign to this row and do not edit `boundary-roster.security.ts`.

Write the safe-observation regression first and run it red against production. Keep the same-key/same-request/same-derived-bytes control and assert it returns `REPLAYED` without appending an event. Add the divergence fixture with the same project, attempt, provider-run record, request bytes, correlation-neutral derived observation, aggregate, and expected version, changing only `CommandDecisionKey.commandId`; assert exactly one of the two production calls is admitted, one durable observation exists, and the loser is exactly `SAFE_BOUNDARY_COMMIT_CONFLICT` at `DAEMON_SAFE_BOUNDARY_OBSERVATION` with the store conflict retained as upstream. Prefix the focused unit/security cases `TASK-F8`. The fixture must avoid every other fence: both inputs are canonical, the run is readable and observed, and the derived payload bytes are identical, so only cross-key ownership can distinguish them; loosening that one guard must turn the current 1-admit assertion into 2.

Implement the minimum safe-observation fix: remove the byte-equality fallback that currently converts a different-key expected-version conflict into `REPLAYED`. Let the durable decision store remain the sole authority for same-key replay; on a thrown or returned non-committed decision for another key, return the existing stable `SAFE_BOUNDARY_COMMIT_CONFLICT` at `DAEMON_SAFE_BOUNDARY_OBSERVATION` and preserve the store result/error in `upstreamCode`. Do not alter the observation/event/ref shapes, refusal vocabulary, aggregate identity, or consumer signatures. Delete the now-false cross-caller replay commentary and unused helper/imports, and compact the touched source to the <=250-line target without moving authority to another subsystem.

Make the already-implemented budget and worktree commit fences mechanically visible without changing their contracts. In the budget test, define a named nonempty tamper roster that drives `readGoalBudgetIdentity` over malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8, and a `GoalCreated` type/content mismatch; pin every result to `BUDGET_PROJECTION_CORRUPT` at `BUDGET_CURRENT_PROJECTION`, keep the real-writer acceptance and clean absence control, and assert the generated case count before iterating. In the worktree test, name and count the production materializer tamper arms: a foreign repository occupying the registered derived path at the same commit must refuse `RUNNER_WORKSPACE_WORKTREE_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH` at `WORKTREE_NODE`, and the single-deviation adoption roster must continue to pin each exact code/layer. Keep real git repositories, detached HEAD, clean bytes, and same commit in the foreign-owner fixture so ownership is the only refusing fence; retain the pre-staged same-owner adoption control so fail-closed-everything cannot pass.

Add a separate frozen `DURABLE_STORE_CLOSURE_NAMES` tuple containing exactly `CUTOVER_ATTEMPT_LAYER`, `CUTOVER_GENERATION_SNAPSHOT_LAYER`, and `IMPORT_GENERATION_READ_LAYER`; do not advertise them in the master/rostered durable tuple yet. Generate dedicated BEFORE/AFTER/RACE cases from that tuple, assert the tuple and generated boundary sets are equal in both directions, assert exactly three subjects and one nonzero arm per phase, and grade them in a `TASK-F8` describe. Every driver must call the real production reader/writer: cutover-attempt uses absent/unreadable durable state plus the interleaved approval writer and pins `CUTOVER_ATTEMPT_STATE_ABSENT`, `CUTOVER_ATTEMPT_EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE`, and `CUTOVER_ATTEMPT_EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT` at `DAEMON_CUTOVER_ATTEMPT`; generation snapshot seeds all four real facts then isolates missing/tampered evidence and horizon drift, pinning its exported `DAEMON_CUTOVER_GENERATION` codes; import generation uses committed import/receipt bytes then isolates invalid input, receipt mismatch, and horizon drift at `DAEMON_IMPORT_GENERATION`. For each AFTER/RACE fixture, explicitly keep all earlier and downstream inputs valid and read back durable counts/horizons so the named subject is the only layer able to answer. Keep the existing 18-entry roster comparison untouched for task-45839f34, the declared downstream consumer that will publish the three names after this row lands.

Run the concentrated verification gate. The exact owned-slice command for `complete_task` evidence is: `node --input-type=module -e "import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process'; const exe=process.platform==='win32'?'pnpm.exe':'pnpm'; const legs=[['--filter','@moe/daemon','exec','vitest','run','--root','.','--config','package.json','src/work/safe-boundary-observation.test.ts','src/budget/budget-durable-binding.test.ts'],['--filter','@moe/runner','exec','vitest','run','--root','../..','packages/runner/src/workspace/worktree-materializer-node.test.ts'],['exec','tsc','-p','tests/security/tsconfig.json'],['exec','vitest','run','--config','tests/security/vitest.config.ts','tests/security/durable-store-boundaries.security.ts','-t','TASK-F8'],['--filter','@moe/daemon','typecheck'],['--filter','@moe/runner','typecheck']]; for (const args of legs){ console.log('VERIFY',exe,...args); const r=spawnSync(exe,args,{shell:false,stdio:'inherit'}); if(r.error) throw r.error; if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status??1); }"`. Run it foreground/unpiped and require nonzero `Test Files`/`Tests` count lines from every Vitest leg. Then rerun, separately and unpiped, the broad commands captured in step 1 plus the full durable-store security file; compare merge-base vs HEAD failing paths, require no newly failing owned path and no owned-package failure, and disclose every surviving foreign roster failure verbatim. Do not call the full security lane green while task-45839f34 remains outstanding.

Perform the final adversarial review and restored mutation drills. Check concurrent double-submit, same-key retry, null/malformed inputs, store/read failures, durable fragments, Windows/macOS/Linux path and git-owner normalization, resource cleanup, exact refusal provenance, and whether any generated sweep can silently yield zero. Before mutation, run `git status --porcelain` on every exact mutated path. On tracked owned production files, one degree at a time: (a) restore cross-key byte replay in `safe-boundary-observation.ts` and require the named one-admit/conflict assertions to red; (b) collapse budget `UNREADABLE` to `MISSING` and require the exact CORRUPT assertion to red; (c) make the node verifier compare the inspected owner to itself while leaving HEAD/detached/clean checks intact and require the foreign-same-commit ownership assertion to red. For the three pre-existing durable subjects, delete one generated closure member/phase at a time and require the exact set-equality/denominator assertion to red; never substitute a hand-built refusal for a production call. Restore each path separately, prove tracked restoration with an empty exact-path diff, rerun the exact owned-slice command green with nonzero counts, inspect the final diff for only the amended nine-path roster, and include mutation names/results plus baseline-vs-HEAD attribution in the completion summary for QA.
